string.text: Days of Food
Show how many days your food will last on the campaign map bar instead of how many food items you carry. Off: the vanilla food count comes back at the next map bar refresh.
Show tenths of a day
On: show 4.5d. Off: show whole days only (4d), rounded down, so 4d means at least 4 full days.
Red at (days or less)
The number turns red when this many whole days of food or fewer are left. 0 means only when less than one day is left.
Blinking red at (days or less)
The number blinks red when this many whole days of food or fewer are left. This wins over plain red. 0 means only when less than one day is left.
Blink speed (seconds)
How long the number stays red, and then normal, in each blink.
Blink between dark and bright red
On: the blinking number goes from dark red to bright red. Off: it goes from the normal color to red.
Announcement at the top of the screen
Show a message at the top of the screen when food drops to the red days, and again when it drops to the blinking days.
Map notification

Show a dismissable notification on the right of the map, like the ones for wars and army dispersals, when food drops to the red days and again at the blinking days. Right click or click it to dismiss. It isn't kept in your save.
Debug messages
Each time the days or the color change, show the food, daily consumption, days left and the chosen color in the chat log. Useful for checking the mod; turn it off for normal play.
